description: [baiduhot] Get the current Baidu real-time hot search ranking (百度热搜榜): what Chinese internet users are searching for right now. Use it for Chinese news and trending topics; use hackernews_front_page for English tech news. Returns up to 50 entries of word (topic in Chinese), index (rank; the pinned item has none) and url (Baidu search link).
name: baiduhot_realtime
title: Baidu hot search: realtime
